title: A 3-year prospective randomized clinical trial of alveolar bone crest response and clinical parameters through 1, 2, and 3 years of clinical function of implants placed 4 months after alveolar ridge preservation using two different allogeneic bone-grafting materials Solakoğlu Ö, Ofluoğlu D
authors: Schwarzenbach H, Heydecke G, Reißmann D, Ergun S, Götz W. Int J Implant Dent. 2022 Feb;8(1):5. doi: 10.1186/s40729-022-00402-w.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “To the best of our knowledge, this study is within its limitations the first study to directly compare ABC -changes and differences in RR of two different allogeneic grafting materials for a period of 3 years after ARP. It was demonstrated to be, despite s ignificant differences in RR, a successful method of preserving increased ABC levels through 1, 2, and 3 years of clinical function” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
